listing.title: Noctalia: Dream Journal
listing.short_description: A living dream journal to notice patterns and explore possible meanings.
listing.full_description:
Every dream leaves a trace. Noctalia turns what you remember into a living dream journal that grows night after night.

Capture a dream when you wake up, by text or optional voice dictation. Add the emotions, symbols, and details you remember, then return to them in a clear, personal journal.

A JOURNAL THAT GROWS WITH YOU
• Save dreams before they fade.
• Browse them by date, search your journal, and notice what returns.
• Observe recurring emotions, themes, and symbols over time.

POSSIBILITIES, NEVER A FINAL ANSWER
• Explore reflection prompts grounded in your dream.
• Discuss a detail to consider what it may mean to you.
• Use the symbol dictionary and guides as starting points, never as certain meanings.

A VISUAL MEMORY OF YOUR DREAM
• Give shape to the dream’s atmosphere with a dream-inspired illustration.
• Return to each entry as an organized memory without forcing one interpretation.

YOUR SPACE, YOUR PACE
Noctalia helps you remember, observe, and reflect. Its analyses and dream interpretations offer possible perspectives. They are not a diagnosis, medical or psychological advice, or a prediction.

Start your dream journal and let your nighttime story take shape, one dream at a time.
